review_notes.cross_repo_corruption_impossible: The worst case -- rewriting OutroDono/OutroRepo@v3 to this project's v1 -- cannot happen: actionRefPattern is anchored to the literal Mpaape/AurumCode@, so it is structurally out of reach rather than merely absent from a list.
review_notes.sha_handling: A 40-hex SHA passes untouched with and without a list; a 7-character one is rewritten, which is right because it is not an immutable pin.
review_notes.neighbour_intact: AUR-465's exact-equality link sanitiser is byte-unchanged, and its own mutations still detect -- the reviewer checked that AUR-465's e2e sed still matches SanitizeActionRef's signature line, so that card's mutation did not quietly become decoration.
review_notes.no_list_path_is_not_dead_code: PublishedTags() never returns empty at the single production call site today, but SanitizeActionRefTags is an exported contract the card's own AC-003 requires, with direct coverage. Declared defensive design, not false coverage.
review_notes.followup: The published-tag literal is maintained by hand with no guard. The reviewer confirmed experimentally that an unlisted v1.0.2 IS rewritten to v1, violating the function's own contract -- the same class of defect this card fixes, applied recursively to its own list. Carded as AUR-478.
